turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have about twenty minutes, and I'm not spending them on pleasantries. Owen found out about this zero from his phone, in the middle of class. Why didn't anyone call me?
I didn't ask how you understand me, Hale. I asked why nobody called me before that zero went in. Answer the question.
But I'm not changing the grade.
Then tell me on what basis, Hale. Who decided, and was Owen asked a single question before it went in? If that's your whole answer, I'm going upstairs from here.
I'm still not changing it. Keep going if you like.

"I'm still not changing it." That's a position, Hale, not a reason. Procedure 4.2 says the parent is contacted before any mark is entered, and 4.3 says software alone doesn't establish a concern. I have both printed, so which one are you telling me doesn't apply?
You can say it ten more ways. The answer is no.
"The answer is no." I'm writing that down, Hale, with the time. Then I'll ask you once more what you have besides a score, and if the answer is nothing, the principal's office is my next stop.
